text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend an accessible loading zone on Niagara Street, in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 8:30 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, to operate as an accessible parking space. This designation will remove two overnight permit parking spaces.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the accessible loading zone, operating from 7:30 a.m. to 8:30 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Niagara Street, from a point 32 metres south of Wellington Street West to a point 11 metres further south, to an accessible parking space at all times.
